title: Is There a Boat From Funchal to Câmara de Lobos?
description: No regular ferry or water taxi links Funchal and Câmara de Lobos. Take the bus, a taxi or the seafront walk, and see the bay from the water on a boat trip.

images.prompt: Realistic drone photograph from about 120 metres up and a little offshore, late afternoon in spring, warm side light from the west. Below, the small round bay of Câmara de Lobos, Madeira: the curved harbour wall, a cluster of brightly painted wooden fishing boats in blue, red and yellow, the dark pebble beach of Vigário, and white houses with terracotta roofs climbing the slope. Just outside the harbour mouth, a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy heads west with a short white wake, a few tiny figures on board seen from above. The cliff of Cabo Girão rises at the left edge of the frame. True colours, no text.
